text: 8-year-old girl. The patient was brought to the emergency department because of a 2-day history of low-grade fever, itchy rash, and generalized joint pain. One week ago, she was diagnosed with acute sinusitis and started on amoxicillin. She has no history of adverse drug reactions, and her immunizations are up to date.
